blockedIdentities.detail: ALLTEC is used by unrelated industrial, electrical and technology companies; the raw record does not independently establish the grounding and surge-protection company as the intended entity.
CBI is a generic abbreviation used by multiple industrial manufacturers and no manufacturer-owned source could be tied safely to this raw identity.
DELTECH resolves to multiple unrelated equipment and materials businesses; the intended manufacturer identity is not established by the raw record.
HYDRO can denote Norsk Hydro, water-treatment brands and multiple hydraulic-equipment companies; no exact manufacturer-owned identity match is available.
KELLER is shared by multiple industrial manufacturers, including pressure-instrumentation and geotechnical companies; the raw record is insufficient to select one.
KOCH is shared by several unrelated machinery, filtration and process-technology manufacturers; no exact identity relation is proven.
LMF is an abbreviation used by multiple industrial companies and the raw identity cannot be mapped to one manufacturer-owned domain without guessing.

profiles.shortDescription: VAHLE develops electrification and automation systems for mobile industrial equipment. Its portfolio covers power transmission, data communication, positioning and control.
fullDescription: Paul Vahle GmbH & Co. KG is a German manufacturer founded in 1912 and headquartered in Kamen. The company develops coordinated electrification and automation technologies for moving industrial equipment.

Its vPOWER, vCOM, vPOS and vDRIVE ranges include conductor systems, festoons, cable reels, contactless power, charging contacts, data links, positioning systems and mobile controls for cranes, intralogistics, ports, automotive production and amusement rides.

profiles.shortDescription: Van der Graaf manufactures enclosed drum motors and conveyor-drive equipment. Its range includes hygienic, standard and heavy-duty drum motors, CrossDrive units and belt-cleaning systems.
fullDescription: Van der Graaf is a conveyor-drive manufacturer whose official literature traces the business to 1948. The VDG drum motor integrates the electric motor, gear reducer and bearings inside the drive roller.

Product families include SSV hygienic drum motors, Standard and GrizzlyDrive units, IntelliDrive permanent-magnet systems, CrossDrive conveyor heads and powered belt cleaners for food, parcel, baggage, warehousing, mining and bulk-material handling.

profiles.shortDescription: Varvel manufactures gear reducers, gearmotors and mechanical speed variators. Its modular range covers worm, helical, bevel-helical, shaft-mounted, planetary and parallel-shaft designs.
fullDescription: Varvel S.p.A. is an Italian power-transmission manufacturer based in Valsamoggia. Its official product directory documents modular gearboxes and gearmotors for small- and medium-power industrial applications.

The range includes RS and RT worm gearboxes, RA and TA helical-worm units, RD helical, RO and RV bevel-helical, RN parallel-shaft and RG reduced-backlash planetary gearboxes, plus VAR mechanical speed variators and accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: Wandfluh develops hydraulic valves, electronics, control assemblies and power units. Its modular products support industrial, mobile, energy, marine and subsea hydraulic systems.
fullDescription: Wandfluh AG is a Swiss family-owned hydraulic-technology manufacturer operating since 1946 and based in Frutigen. It develops standard and customised hydraulic and electronic components.

The range includes directional, pressure, flow and proportional valves, PMV and CMV mobile-valve platforms, control electronics, software, manifold assemblies and hydraulic power units, including corrosion- and explosion-protected variants.

profiles.shortDescription: Altra Industrial Motion is a legacy power-transmission group identity covering brakes, clutches, couplings, gearing and motion-control products. Current ownership and product continuity sit within Regal Rexnord.
fullDescription: Official Altra product literature documents a portfolio of mechanical power-transmission, motion-control and engine-braking technologies across multiple specialist brands. Regal Rexnord acquired Altra Industrial Motion, so this page treats Altra as a verified legacy group identity rather than an independent current manufacturer.

The documented scope includes industrial brakes and clutches, couplings, geared products, belted drives, overrunning clutches, torque limiters and supporting motion-control components for machinery, energy, material handling and transportation.

profiles.shortDescription: AUMA designs and manufactures electric valve actuators, gearboxes and actuator controls. Its modular systems automate multi-turn, part-turn and linear valves in energy, water and process plants.
fullDescription: AUMA Riester GmbH & Co. KG is a German actuator-technology manufacturer with six decades of experience. Official company pages identify electric actuators and valve gearboxes as its core products.

The range includes SA and SAR multi-turn actuators, SQ and SQR part-turn actuators, PROFOX and TIGRON platforms, manual gearboxes, actuator controls, communication systems and accessories for water, power, oil and gas, petrochemical, marine and industrial applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Cryostar designs cryogenic rotating machinery and process solutions. Its portfolio covers cryogenic pumps, expanders, compressors, blowers, heat exchangers, liquefaction and gas-filling systems.
fullDescription: Cryostar is a French cryogenic-equipment manufacturer established in 1967, with its decision-making and research centre in Hésingue, Alsace. It develops machinery for industrial and medical gases, LNG, hydrogen and clean-energy processes.

Products include centrifugal and reciprocating cryogenic pumps, expansion turbines, cryogenic compressors and blowers, heat exchangers, small-scale liquefaction units, vaporizers, cylinder-filling stations and LNG or LCNG refuelling systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Electro Adda designs and manufactures industrial AC motors and asynchronous generators. Its range includes brake, slip-ring, explosion-proof, water-cooled, roller-table, high-temperature and marine motors.
fullDescription: Electro Adda S.p.A. is an Italian electric-motor manufacturer founded in 1948 and based in Beverate di Brivio. Official company material documents in-house production of three-phase motors from fractional ratings to 1.5 MW.

The portfolio includes standard squirrel-cage motors, brake motors, asynchronous generators, slip-ring motors, ATEX explosion-proof designs, water-cooled motors, roller-table motors, high-temperature smoke-extraction motors and marine propulsion or manoeuvring motors.

profiles.shortDescription: Eletta develops and manufactures flow monitors, switches, indicators and transmitters for liquids, gases and steam. Its mechanical and electronic instruments support industrial process supervision.
fullDescription: Eletta is a Swedish process-instrumentation manufacturer founded in 1947 and based in Segeltorp. Official pages describe measurement technologies for monitoring liquid, gas and steam flow.

The range includes mechanical flow monitors, indicators, alarm switches, transmitters and digital instruments with analogue, pulse, HART and Modbus communications. D-, S-, V- and related series support process and machine applications across industry.

profiles.shortDescription: EVAPCO manufactures heat-transfer and refrigeration equipment. Its portfolio includes cooling towers, closed-circuit coolers, condensers, evaporators, thermal-storage and water-treatment systems.
fullDescription: EVAPCO, Inc. designs and manufactures equipment for evaporative cooling, industrial refrigeration and heat-transfer applications. Manufacturer-owned pages organize the range for commercial HVAC, industrial process, data centres, refrigeration and power generation.

Products include factory-assembled cooling towers, evaporative and air-cooled condensers, closed-circuit coolers, evaporators, transcritical CO2 systems, hygienic air handlers, thermal-energy storage, pressure-vessel packages, controls and water-treatment systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Fleck is a Pentair water-treatment brand for residential and commercial control valves and accessories. Its valves manage softening, filtration and regeneration functions in treatment systems.
fullDescription: Fleck Controls was founded in the United States in 1950 and acquired by Pentair in 1995. Pentair continues to present Fleck as a distinct control-valve brand for residential and commercial water treatment.

The official range includes filter and softener control valves, electronic controllers, bypass and connection options, and accessories. Named platforms include 2510, 2750, 2815, 2850, 2900, 3150, 3900, 5800, 5810 and 5812.

profiles.shortDescription: HP Valves designs and manufactures high-pressure isolation, control and steam-conditioning valves. Its forged and cast-steel products serve power, energy and severe process applications.
fullDescription: HP Valves Oldenzaal B.V. is a Netherlands-based valve manufacturer headquartered in Hengelo and owned by Indutrade. Official company material documents more than four decades of engineering for high-energy piping and critical services.

The portfolio includes pressure-seal gate, globe and check valves, severe-service control valves, steam-conditioning valves, turbine-bypass and attemperator systems, plus upgrades and replacement parts for power and process installations.

profiles.shortDescription: Motovario manufactures gear reducers, gearmotors, electric motors, drives and mechanical speed variators. Its product line covers worm, helical, bevel, planetary and heavy-duty transmission systems.
fullDescription: Motovario S.p.A. is an Italian power-transmission manufacturer. The official product directory covers mechanical and electronic drive components for industrial machinery.
Families include H helical, B bevel-helical, S shaft-mounted, HPL planetary, MHD heavy-duty and VSF worm gear reducers, VAR speed variators, M electric motors, D drives and E electronics.

profiles.shortDescription: Reggiana Riduttori designs and manufactures planetary gearboxes, gearmotors and wheel or track drives. Its range supports industrial, mobile, marine, agricultural and lifting applications.
fullDescription: Reggiana Riduttori is an Italian power-transmission manufacturer with fifty years of documented experience. It develops modular planetary gears, gearmotors and wheel-drive technologies.

The portfolio includes 2000 and PLUS planetary ranges, RRWD wheel and RRTD track drives, slewing and winch gearboxes, mixer drives, helical and bevel-helical gearboxes, V combined drives and BERMA agricultural transmission components.

profiles.shortDescription: Robatech develops industrial adhesive-application systems for hot-melt adhesives and cold glue. Its portfolio includes melters, delivery units, heated hoses, application heads, controls and integrated gluing systems.
fullDescription: Robatech AG is a Swiss manufacturer of industrial adhesive-application technology based in Muri. Manufacturer-owned pages document complete systems for controlled application of hot-melt, reactive and cold adhesives.

The range includes melters, cold-glue delivery units, heated hoses, jetting, spraying and coating heads, hand applicators, accessories and Robatech Control System platforms. Application systems support packaging, converting, hygiene products, woodworking, automotive and other automated manufacturing processes.
